title: Transfer of one quantified step
statement: Let $b$ be a Boolean value, and let $B,m$ be nonnegative integers. Suppose $d$ maps bit strings of length $B$ to bit strings of length $m$, every length-$m$ bit string is the image under $d$ of some length-$B$ bit string, and for every length-$B$ string $v$, $Q'(v)$ holds exactly when $Q(d(v))$ holds. Then the statement that there exists a length-$B$ string satisfying $Q'$ when $b$ is true, or that every length-$B$ string satisfies $Q'$ when $b$ is false, is equivalent to the corresponding existential or universal statement for length-$m$ strings and predicate $Q$.
hypotheses_covered: $d$ maps every length-$B$ string to a length-$m$ string
